evidence_type: Assistant in-memory transcription of the learner-supplied DBeaver result screenshot; no direct database read.
query_type: Single read-only comparison for all ten stores and TOTAL; no table created or updated.
selection_policy: Same accepted highest-90-day-unit A x Z product, with item_id ascending as tie-break. Preserve all ten stores including true zeros; missing daily records fail rather than being treated as zero.
share_policy: Late share uses all stores late-window units, not net change. Zero late-window denominator gives NULL in every share including TOTAL. Signed unit differences and equal-length windows describe recorded-sales changes only.
display_normalization: Unit totals and signed differences are canonical JSON integers. Late-window percentages are numeric strings padded to four decimals by restoring omitted trailing zeros. TOTAL state is JSON null. Comparison-window strings, product/store/state labels and PASS statuses are preserved only within the in-memory canonical eleven-column rows before hashing.
fingerprint_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 compact JSON with sorted object keys and ensure_ascii=False. Store report rows remain in store_id ascending order with TOTAL last; units/differences are JSON integers, late shares four-decimal strings or NULL. Identifiers occur only in memory before hashing.
scope: All eleven learner screenshot rows and eleven displayed fields were transcribed only in memory. The ordered canonical store-report SHA-256 fingerprint matches the historical assistant preflight and its independent reference. Counts, integer totals, signed differences, percentages, both comparison windows, store order, TOTAL placement and its NULL state all agree. Public acceptance contains only cross-store aggregates and a report fingerprint, without real product/store identifiers, individual store rows, vectors or screenshots. It confirms learner execution and displayed results, not a fresh direct audit of the learner database or 840 daily source cells. Independent source reconstruction, original store/state mapping, full 3,049-product fields, selected daily/week reconciliation, twenty targeted cases, scoped input/source fingerprints and timings remain separate assistant preflight evidence. Interpretation is attributed to the assistant. All ten stores have higher later-window recorded units, but this does not identify demand growth, promotion, launch timing, inventory availability, stockout causes or operating needs. The next planned step reviews weekly price context for the same selected product; learner execution is pending and no causal price effect is claimed.
